ci-bot: nightly-evals job #842 failed quality-thresholds for rdx-2.1-q4_0 (repetition spike). details: https://ci.redwood/ev/842 :warning:
Amy Chen: saw the alert, grabbing a few examples now. first glance: lots of self-repeats, e.g., 'as a reminder, as a reminder...' repeating 8-12x in several completions.
Mike Alvarez: hmm q4_0 again? recent quant flip for rdx-2.1 pushed last week. cc @Jordan Patel for model bits. :thinking:
Jordan Patel: can you paste one of the raw generations and the prompt id? want to check prompt truncation / tokenizer effects.
Amy Chen: prompt id 20260317-1375, sample below:
Amy Chen: "Prompt: Summarize the CTO's plan for scaling the cluster.
Generation: The CTO said they will add more GPUs. As a reminder, the CTO said they will add more GPUs. As a reminder, the CTO said they will add more GPUs. ..."
Eva Sørensen: ugh that's the classic prefix-loop. quick test: run the same example on rdx-2.1-fp16 and rdx-2.1-q8.
Mike Alvarez: running now: `./tools/run_eval --model rdx-2.1-q4_0 --cases 20260317-1375`
Mike Alvarez: log snippet:
Mike Alvarez: ```
INFO: running case 20260317-1375
OUTPUT: "The CTO said they will add more GPUs. As a reminder, the CTO said they will add more GPUs..."
POSTPROCESS: repeated-seq detected (score 0.88)
```
Jordan Patel: thanks. i just ran fp16 on same case: no repeats, output concise. so regression looks quant-specific.
Eva Sørensen: could be KV-cache alignment or top-k/top-p shift after quantization. did anyone change sampling defaults?
Amy Chen: sampling config is consistent in eval harness. we did change kernel selection to use fused-attn-approx on q4 path last week.
Mike Alvarez: quick ablation: rerun q4_0 with `--force-kernel=exact` to skip fused path. starting...
Mike Alvarez: result: loop gone, output matches fp16. so fused-attn-approx + q4 seems to cause generation instability. :exclamation:
Jordan Patel: good repro. create a PR to disable that kernel for q4 until we validate, and add a focused unit test. I'll open issue with logs + seed.
Amy Chen: filed issue #1297 and PR draft: https://git.redwood/r/1297 - tagging eng-runtime for review.
Eva Sørensen: for next steps: revert kernel selection for q4 in nightly runs, add targeted regression test (sample-case + seed), and run quant kernels against a small prompt suite.
ci-bot: scheduled job 843: nightly-evals (rdx-2.1-q4_0) will run with forced `exact` kernel per Amy's PR.
Mike Alvarez: thanks all. will monitor 843 results and post final counts. :thumbsup:
